predictions.quote: we're not even three months into his presidency. And you forecast that forward. It feels like we're entering an era of spend, spend, spend. predictions.prediction: In the years following early 2021, Biden-era policies of large fiscal stimulus and continued high federal spending will (1) increase overall inflation, (2) increase commodity prices, (3) suppress the rate of wealth creation for the rich compared with the prior trend, and (4) increase real earned income for people without significant investments, leading them to increase consumption.
